name: Lucky Lady’s Clover

features.name: Nine lines
features.description: Traditional letters plus Irish luck symbols.

review:
Lucky Lady's Clover is a 2016 BGaming classic with nine lines, traditional card letters and Irish folklore symbols: rainbows, pots of gold, horseshoes and the Lucky Lady herself.

An optional gamble round follows any base-game win. Its maths is surprisingly strong for its age: BGaming lists a 97.31% RTP, low volatility and a 10,000x maximum. Free spins arrive about once every 319 spins on average. The calm audio design is deliberately unobtrusive. It's an old-school game with excellent long-term value.
pros: Excellent 97.31% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
cons: Bonus is rare (about 1 in 319 spins on average)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
